descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Jet Black' Deep Dark Black Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Jet Black' is a brand new introduction by Buchholz Nursery with deep dark maroon red foliage. 'Jet Black' is perhaps one of the darkest of all the Japanese maples. 'Jet Black' is a strong grower. We expect 'Jet Black' to reach 12-14 ft in 10 years. Fall color is scarlet red. Trees were potted fr om large liners to gallons in this spring and may not have completely filled out their pots.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Jet Black' 深暗近黑色日本枫，适生分区 5-9。 'Jet Black' 是 Buchholz Nursery 最新推出的品种，叶色为极深的栗红色。 'Jet Black' 也许是所有日本枫中颜色最深的品种之一。 'Jet Black' 生长势强健。 我们预计 'Jet Black' 10 年可长至 12-14 英尺。 秋色为猩红色。 这些植株于今年春季由较大的育苗株上盆到加仑盆中，可能尚未完全长满盆。
